title: bn254-pairing-inversion: (6,2) STNFS, run gate, log phase at its modeled expectation: 2^91.032794139

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns (P0,[x]Q0) with e(P0,[x]Q0)=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64) 2^92.388765983 < 2^91.032794139 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). A run gate opens the run only when a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7206618365717393330, the least integer with (K/2^64) x 0.998281 >= 0.39; a closed run is a failure costing 1 unit. In an opened run both individual logarithms run under one combined phase meter of 2^112 units that aborts as failure. The ledger charges that phase at its expected work, at most 2^90.566805 units by the descent recurrence (H5), because the work before an abort never exceeds the uncapped work; and the two-variable Samuels bound of proof.md section 7 on the two independent logarithm works gives P(cap) <= 0.000000354 and opened-run success at least 0.998281. Work and success both rest on H5 as modeled, with no allowance factor. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes the 171 earlier entered-node PGF strata, which the default run also replays. part=h5 recomputes ADAPTIVE.md's conditional next-relation tables (627 attempts after an earlier failed relation, failure and child-work observed/envelope with root-cluster bootstrap) from h5data.b85; the default run checks the totals. These are toy-scale measurements; transfer to production sizes is H5. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim. part=plan prints the current 62-row plan row by row (method, windows, radius, mu, psi, phi, retry, work) with the node budget, E[N] and the abort/repeat losses.
